property_summary: For any fuzzed newOwner, after an owner-initiated transferOwnership the contract's owner must never be the zero address (P reverts on newOwner==0 and otherwise sets a non-zero owner, while M sets owner()==address(0)), so c.owner() != address(0) always holds on P and is violated on M.
change_summary: Delete the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
